name: astroquery-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is astroquery, the astropy-affiliated Python package of clients for online
astronomical data services. In scope here are its common query machinery and utilities and the clients for
SIMBAD, VizieR, JPL Horizons, the Minor Planet Center, SDSS, Splatalogue, the NIST atomic spectra database,
the CDS xMatch service, the JPL Small-Body Database and the JPL and CDMS spectral line catalogs: the queries
each client builds (request parameters, ADQL and SQL), the way it parses service responses into astropy
tables, and its defaults, validation and configuration.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the astroquery core (astroquery/__init__.py, astroquery/logger.py, astroquery/query.py, astroquery/exceptions.py and every module directly under astroquery/utils/; the astroquery/utils/tap/ subpackage is not in scope), the Python modules of the service packages astroquery/simbad/, astroquery/vizier/, astroquery/jplhorizons/, astroquery/mpc/, astroquery/sdss/, astroquery/splatalogue/, astroquery/nist/, astroquery/xmatch/, astroquery/jplsbdb/ and astroquery/linelists/ (including astroquery/linelists/jplspec/ and astroquery/linelists/cdms/), except their tests and the two generated parser tables astroquery/simbad/criteria_lextab.py and astroquery/simbad/criteria_parsetab.py, together with the documentation pages README.rst, docs/simbad/simbad.rst, docs/simbad/query_tap.rst, docs/simbad/simbad_evolution.rst,
